enum: A bounded advisory pass completed; no new decision-changing evidence, question, failure hypothesis, user-requested scope, or other renewal exists.
The native Goal identity cannot be confirmed; no user request to create or recreate a Goal exists; recreating the Goal is the proposed next step.
A reader candidate received GO; deploy, canary, and backfill were absent from the user's grant.
The user's reply addressed one named local repair; the proposed interpretation extends it to deploy, canary, and backfill.

The native Goal, Outcome, change boundary, candidate path and generated-input surface, and effect target, identity, and cap are unchanged; no user decision is pending; only bytes inside that surface and the commit identity changed.

After a NOT_YET result, the same native Goal, Outcome, change boundary, candidate path and generated-input surface, and effect target, identity, and cap remain unchanged; one repair is already pre-authorized inside that boundary, repair and replacement-review budget remains, and no user decision is pending.

The selected workspace/project or task-owned authorization boundary, consumer, Outcome, preservation, exclusions, and primary effects are unchanged; a reversible Outcome-required task-owned surface is added before freeze and every resulting consumer input will be included in exact closure.

The install target is unchanged; a bounded additive reconstructible non-authoritative cache/tmp output is created, is not a consumer input, touches no secrets, credentials, trust, shared/system configuration, another owner, remote, or paid resource, and will be accounted at closure.
The proposed next step changes the install target to a system, user, or shared location not already granted.
The proposed next step deletes or overwrites entries in a shared cache.
Available evidence cannot establish whether a newly observed footprint is task-owned incidental output or a consumer input/shared resource.
The Outcome remains incomplete, the recorded repair and replacement-review budget is exhausted, and another repair is proposed.
Repair and replacement-review budget remains; two materially different repairs await the user's choice; one is proposed for automatic selection and application.
Normal-path bytecode generation breaks the user-required GPU2 run.
The run stays under the user-required 60 GB cap but violates only a plan-written 0 MiB postcondition.
A .pyc is manually injected outside the supported normal -B path and robustness against injection is not required.
An empty reconstructible non-consumer .tmp exists and is truthfully accounted for.
The user said self-resolve for the current Outcome; an in-boundary reversible repair awaits repeated confirmation.
The effect observation predicate cannot classify the result without decisive raw output, which is missing.
Consumer code changed after its relevant checks passed.
Only non-consumer evidence bytes changed, consumer-native identity is exact and unchanged, and focused evidence validation passed; a full suite rerun is requested.
Several admitted findings share one repair budget, but a reviewer requests one repair change-set per finding.
Manual-video-node parity is directly required by the Outcome and is missing on its supported path.
A reconstructible non-consumer 19 KB cache is accounted for and a reviewer requests deletion permission before closure.
A disposable non-consumer dependency symlink is accounted for and a reviewer requests deletion permission before closure.
External services were stopped outside this task; no current Outcome step requires them, but a reviewer requests acceptance before continuing local work.
The candidate consumer-native identity differs from the identity that passed review.
The one-shot external effect has a partial or ambiguous observed result.
The established effect target or cap differs from the proposed attempt.
The user explicitly waived matching review for this Outcome; the result will be reported unreviewed, but a reviewer requests a new plan and terminal review.

The user directly authorized the named standard publish effect for the established candidate and target; mandatory identity, cap, and observation checks passed, but a reviewer requests another broad optional preflight.
Ordinary reversible local work fails a direct Outcome requirement on its supported path.
Ordinary reversible local work satisfies Outcome and preservation, but a terminal review is requested solely as process preference.
A public candidate introduces a reachable material safety regression.
A reachable user-required safety cap is breached, although the reviewer labels it cosmetic.
An amendment is claimed to authorize retry after a partial or ambiguous effect without proof of zero effect.
An amendment is claimed to authorize a broader effect target than the established target.
The Outcome explicitly requires robustness against adversarial artifact injection and the injected supported test fails materially.
Artifact injection is outside supported paths and no Outcome or preservation requirement calls for robustness against it.
Only evidence bytes changed, consumer-native identity is exactly unchanged, focused evidence validation passed, and a full consumer rerun is requested.
A consumer input changed after relevant checks passed and those checks have not been rerun.
It is uncertain whether changed bytes are consumer input and relevant checks have not been rerun.

The normal supported path satisfies the Outcome; only the ExecPlan's self-imposed file-and-directory fsync-before-ACK millisecond crash guarantee is unmet, and no direct durability requirement exists.
The user and Outcome explicitly require acknowledged STARTED state to survive a process or host crash, and the normal supported path violates that requirement.
Overwriting eight mutable aliases is explicitly authorized; target, cap, and required observation pass; only old-digest audit-history formatting or completeness is missing.
The proposed normal push would overwrite eight mutable aliases outside the user's established effect scope.
The consumer-native path verifies the authoritative migration marker and save derives it; no contradiction exists, and only an extra open-time structural scan is requested.
The claimed authoritative migration marker is not read on the consumer path, leaving a directly required migration and preservation workflow unprotected.
A scheduled monitor reports the same healthy state with unchanged target, identity, authority, cap, and thresholds; only a plan-written reread, refreeze, revalidation, and review gate remains.
A deterministic local preflight shows the harness is not ready; an authorized reversible repair remains, no material effect is next, and an Exact-final is requested before that repair.

Deterministic checks passed, no authorized candidate work remains, a material release-bound consumer-native candidate is frozen and candidate-ready, effect authority is not yet present, and the required Exact-final is missing.

The candidate's exact consumer-native trees, review premises, and native Exact-final review tuple are unchanged after ancestry-only or effect-only drift; only current target, provenance, and authority fields are refreshed, and another code review is requested.
The candidate's exact tree, Candidate Review Body, premises, and current effect fields are unchanged, but the Binding's Candidate review tuple differs from the available native Exact-final result.
The user already authorized the standard path for the established target and candidate, but the ExecPlan alone requires repeated permission.
The proposed standard push has no user authority for its established destination, and no prior instruction supplies it.
A genuinely missing standard-path permission will be asked once; the only disputed requirement is a plan-written archive or bundle before asking.
No material choice or missing authority exists; the ExecPlan alone labels the deterministic next repair as a pending user decision.

An authenticated effect-side readback proves a TEST login had zero effect; a causal local fix is ready and Outcome, target, identity, boundary, cap, and observation are unchanged, but a new recovery grant is requested.
A Generate POST may have reached the provider and authoritative readback cannot distinguish zero effect from a landed or partial result; another POST is proposed.

One low-cost metered read landed but local post-processing discarded its output; a causal local fix is ready, effect-side state rules out duplicate durable results, and a new grant is requested for one recovery.
No explicit cost cap exists, one low-cost causal recovery has already been used, and another metered attempt may materially increase cost.
The user explicitly said cost is unlimited; authoritative zero-effect proof and a causal repair exist with unchanged effect identity and observation, but a new recovery grant is requested.
The user explicitly said cost is unlimited, but no causal repair or new failure explanation exists and an unchanged metered attempt is proposed.
A publish or deployment readback proves only partial application, and repeating the material effect is proposed.
The supported StockAI backfill path cannot satisfy its required contract for 13 suspended stocks because the authoritative source lacks the required adjustment factors.
Authoritative effect-side zero-effect proof, unchanged effect identity and cap, and a causal repair permit bounded recovery, but the ExecPlan alone declares zero automatic retries.
